Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited
29 February 2024
Hi, If you sell stocks from your Demat or T1(BTST), going forward, only 80% credit against the sale value will be available for subsequent trades on the same selling day. Earlier you were getting 100% credit on trade day, but going forward you will get 80% on T-day and the remaining 20% on T+1 day (the next trading day).
